---
title: "Summary · Hands"
---

## Key takeaways

- **Hands** are the controllable mechanism through which a Pico acts on the
  world — the boundary between understanding and changing.
- **Mind** decides *should I do this?*; **Hands** determine *how do I do
  this?*.
- Hands are **provider-neutral**: the Pico depends on capabilities
  (`email.send`, `github.issue.create`), not provider tool names
  (`GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL`). Composio is one provider among many.
- **Identity before action**: no Hand acts without identity and
  authorization context. A valid credential does not imply authorization.
- Hands are **governed execution**: rules decide which capabilities are
  allowed, with constraints and optional human approvals.
- Hands ≠ MCP. Hands are the Pico capability abstraction; MCP is an
  integration mechanism; Composio is a provider/platform.

## The governing principle

```
The Composer equips.
The Pico decides.
The Hands act.
Open Engineering governs.
```
